en.B: B) Minimum required operating speed of 10 km/h for heavy vehicles.
en.C: C) Axle massload limit of 10 tonnes per axle.

xh.C: C) Umda womthwalo wearali wa 10 tonnes nge-axle nganye.

st.C: C) Moedi wa boima ba axle ba 10 tonnes ka axle ka nngwe.
